digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge status and canary reconciler
propositions: Create canonical `rebar bridge status` read-only command that reads authoritative durable last-pass ref, optional rich detail file, pause state, and live lock metadata to emit verdicts HEALTHY/PAUSED/RUNNING/STALE/FOREIGN/NEVER_RUN/FAILED with exact exit codes.

Consolidate two pass-record producers into one: mutating reconciler writes minimal JSON truth to `refs/reconciler/last-pass` via observed-OID CAS with exactly three attempts (100/200 ms backoff) before lock release, recording success or process-surviving hard failure but not SIGKILL/OOM.

Re-introduce hidden compatibility alias `bridge-status` routable through identical `_bridge_commands` parser while canonical `bridge status` is documented; preserve all preview/sync/pause/resume behavior and retire purge-bridge.

Scope environment identity (explicit REBAR_ENV_ID wins; else stable local:<repo-env-id> from .env-id, never falling back to reconciler) only to new last-pass writer and status target, leaving inbound event metadata and legacy Jira inference unchanged.

Canary takes two read-only lock-fence snapshots separated by observed holder lease_secs (reject >480s before 10-minute timeout) to classify same OID/fence as CRASHED while rejecting/omitting wall-clock heartbeat; default to canonical status instead of GitHub API after producer bootstrap write.

Prove all behavioral contracts RED-first: verdicts/exits, env isolation, no-mutation, hard-failure recording before lock release, CAS contention handling, rich-detail mismatch safety, SIGKILL-witness fence classification, canary ref-fetch/escalation/API-query absence, and legacy command parity; remove old producers and baselines with semantic and string-reference sweeps; create ADR 0094 documenting authoritative ref and two-witness extension of ADR 0031 prior art.
